invoking_agent: human_operator_session (Claude Code debugging session, explicit human instruction)
decision_description: Root-cause correction of the systematic Phase 8 drafting failures observed in runs a79ed11e-f2dd-4493-99d5-68553d3bd7c6 and 511325a3-12c9-4651-ae99-1f6074750c38 (2026-07-29). The MSCA-PF criterion-level parent headings (section_id 1, 2, 3) in docs/tier2a_instrument_schemas/extracted/section_schema_registry.json carried section_type 'proposal_section', which admitted them into the Phase 8 decomposed-drafting granularity (InstrumentProfile.drafting_sub_sections). Each run therefore drafted 12 sub-sections instead of the intended 9 leaves, and the three parent drafts were monolithic whole-criterion generations — the longest calls in every run. Observed consequences: n08b_impact_drafting ClaudeCLITimeoutError at 1200s on parent sub-section '2'; n08a_excellence_drafting failure on parent sub-section '1' where a front-truncated over-long transport response was salvaged by runner/skill_runtime._extract_json_response into an interior source_refs fragment (parsed keys ['source_path','tier']), surfacing as a misleading "produced no 'content' prose" error.
alternatives_considered: Filter parent headings in code (exclude sections referenced as parent_section_id) while leaving the registry data as-is — rejected: the registry would remain contradictory with the ticket-5 extraction, the test suite's asserted nine-leaf granularity, and the decomposed-drafting design; the data, not the code, drifted.
Only raise the drafter timeout — rejected: it treats the symptom (parent calls are the longest) and leaves the duplicated whole-criterion content and truncation exposure in place.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §12.3 (contradictions between tiers must be resolved explicitly and recorded); §6.4 (reruns must update Tier 4 state deterministically from inputs); §17.6.5 / §17.5.4 (the runtime must not silently repair malformed Claude responses). Authority resolution: the ticket-5 Tier 2A extraction (commit 5afd8f8, parents typed 'criterion_section'), the decomposed-drafting design, and the asserted test contract (tests/runner/test_instrument_profile.py::test_real_registries_resolve_msca_pf, nine B1 leaf sub-sections) prevail over the 2026-07-28 re-extraction (commit aa5dafe), which flattened the parents to 'proposal_section' in order to comply with the four-value section_type enum in .claude/workflows/system_orchestration/artifact_schema_specification.yaml — an enum that had never been updated to include the 'criterion_section' value the design depends on.
rationale: The drift chain: (1) artifact_schema_specification.yaml declared section_type enum [proposal_section, implementation_section, cover_page, annexe] without 'criterion_section'; (2) the instrument-schema-normalization re-extraction of 2026-07-28 (commit aa5dafe) 'corrected' the parent headings 1/2/3 from 'criterion_section' to 'proposal_section' to satisfy that enum (recorded in the registry's section_type_correction_note); (3) InstrumentProfile.drafting_sub_sections includes every proposal_section/implementation_section entry, so decomposed drafting began drafting the parents as full sub-sections; (4) the known-failing test test_real_registries_resolve_msca_pf flagged the regression but was misclassified as out-of-scope taxonomy drift. Resolution applied under explicit human instruction: (a) 'criterion_section' added to the enum in artifact_schema_specification.yaml and to the instrument-schema-normalization skill spec (both enum statements and the Step 2.2 classification rule), so future re-extractions preserve the taxonomy; (b) registry parents 1/2/3 restored to 'criterion_section' and the section_type_correction_note rewritten; (c) runner/decomposed_drafting.py now removes stale drafts/spine from a prior run before drafting (§6.4 — a sub-section leaving the drafting set must not strand an undeclared draft that blocks the fail-closed assembler) and the drafter timeout was raised 1200s→1800s (leaf calls measured 6-17 min live); (d) runner/skill_runtime._extract_json_response salvage scan now rejects interior fragments of front-truncated responses (candidate followed by ',', ':', ']' or '}'), so truncation fails closed as unparseable instead of being silently repaired into a misleading fragment (§17.6.5). Also noted for the record: run a79ed11e's n08a failure was a separate defect — the proposal-section-traceability-check skill catalog entry lacked the Tier 1-4 reference directories its own Step 1.5 requires; that fix (optional_reads_from extension in skill_catalog.yaml) was applied in-session on 2026-07-29 before run 511325a3 and is included in the same working-tree change set.
